title: Repo bootstrap: Next.js+TS scaffold, tooling, scripts, CI
ac: npm ci && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build pass; scripts dev/build/start/lint/typecheck/test/db:reset/eval exist; .github/workflows/ci.yml runs them; LICENSE, .gitignore, .env.example committed; folder skeleton from docs/DIRECTORY_TREE.md exists with .gitkeep files.

title: Shared contracts: zod schemas + escrow transition table (src/shared/*)
ac: src/shared/contracts.ts exports every type in MANUAL §8 and §9.2 (Money, Criterion, Job, PaymentSummary, EventItem, VerificationReportSchema, ForensicsReport, Decision, SettlementProposal, ApiError); src/shared/escrow.ts exports ESCROW_STATUSES, TRANSITIONS, canTransition(); unit tests cover every allowed and 3 illegal transitions. FROZEN after merge (contract-change label required).

title: DB schema (Drizzle + better-sqlite3), repositories, seed script
ac: src/server/db/schema.ts matches MANUAL §6; npm run db:reset creates ./data/proofpay.db and seeds 3 demo jobs (bike, cleaning, delivery) in CREATED; repo functions getJob/listJobs/insertEvent/updateStatus typed; unit test with in-memory db.

title: PayPal REST client: OAuth token cache, ppFetch, PayPal-Request-Id, error mapping
ac: src/server/paypal/client.ts: getAccessToken caches until expiry-60s; ppFetch sets Bearer, Prefer: return=representation, PayPal-Request-Id; PayPalError(status, issue, debugId); unit tests with mocked fetch; scripts/paypal-smoke.ts gets a sandbox token (run manually).

title: Orders v2: create (intent AUTHORIZE) + authorize + get; API endpoints 5–6
ac: POST /api/paypal/orders returns orderId from sandbox; POST /api/paypal/orders/:id/authorize stores authorization id, status, expiration_time, honor_period_ends_at, generates 4-digit liveness code, moves job to AUTHORIZED; manual sandbox test logged in PR with order id and authorization id.

title: Payments v2: capture full/partial (final_capture), void, refund, reauthorize, get auth
ac: src/server/paypal/payments.ts exports captureAuthorization(authId,{amount?,finalCapture:true,invoiceId}), voidAuthorization, refundCapture, reauthorize, getAuthorization; idempotency rows in paypal_idempotency; sandbox test notes in PR: partial capture of 80% then GET authorization shows remaining released (record actual behaviour in docs/REFERENCES.md).

title: Escrow state machine + settle.ts (PayPal side effects before transitions)
ac: transition() atomic with events row; IllegalTransition -> 409; settle(job, decision) does capture/partial/void; AUTO_CAPTURE_ON_APPROVE honoured; PARTIAL capture requires customer accept event; tests cover each path with mocked PayPal.

title: Job + evidence API routes (endpoints 1–4, 7–9, 11–15, 17, 20, 21) with withErrors()
ac: All routes in MANUAL §8 respond with documented shapes (zod-validated); upload limits enforced; role cookie checked; route tests via vitest + next test helpers or supertest-like handler calls; curl examples in docs/API_EXAMPLES.md.

title: Criteria generator (LLM generateObject) + category fallback templates + liveness criterion
ac: generateCriteria(job) returns 3–6 criteria, weights sum 1±0.001, plus system cL liveness criterion; timeout 20s -> template; VISION_MOCK=1 returns template without network; tests for normalisation + fallback.

title: Evidence ingest: sharp resize, sha256, dHash, exifr EXIF; store under UPLOAD_DIR
ac: ingestImage(buffer) -> {sha256,dhash(16 hex),width,height,exifTakenAt?,storedPath}; rejects non-image by sharp metadata; dHash identical for re-encoded copy (hamming<=6) and different for unrelated images (>=20) in tests using eval sample images.

title: Forensics checks (duplicates, before≈after, EXIF window, scene/screenshot flags)
ac: runForensics(job, evidence, vlmReport?) -> ForensicsReport per MANUAL §9.3 table; compares against other jobs and eval/stock; unit tests for each flag.

title: VLM verifier (generateObject, image labelling, retry-on-invalid, mock fixtures)
ac: verifyEvidence() returns VerificationReport (zod) with boxes; prompt exactly as MANUAL §9.2 in src/server/vision/prompts.ts; one retry on zod failure; VISION_MOCK reads eval/fixtures; manual run on 3 eval pairs pasted in PR.

title: Decision engine (pure) + thresholds from env
ac: decide(criteria, report, forensics, amount) implements MANUAL §9.4 exactly; >=12 table-driven unit tests incl. liveness missing, HIGH flag, partial rounding (floor to 0.05).

title: Verification orchestrator: submit -> VERIFYING -> forensics+VLM -> decide -> settle/agent
ac: POST /api/jobs/:id/submit returns 202 and verification completes in-process; verifications row stored; outcome transitions correct; APPROVED auto-captures in sandbox; errors -> HUMAN_REVIEW with reason.

title: Settlement agent v1 (AI SDK tools, policy gate, proposals, evidence pack markdown, PayPal Agent Toolkit read tools)
ac: runSettlementAgent(jobId) writes SettlementProposal event for PARTIAL with explanation citing criterion ids; money tools refuse without approval event (unit-tested); evidence-pack endpoint returns markdown; Agent Toolkit get_order used to show order state in pack; mock mode deterministic.

title: Render deploy: render.yaml, health check, SEED_ON_BOOT, env vars; hosted URL in README
ac: render.yaml blueprint (web service, node, build npm ci && npm run build, start npm start, healthCheckPath /api/health); deployed URL loads and runs happy path in sandbox; README updated with URL.

title: STRETCH: PayPal webhooks route with signature verification
ac: POST /api/webhooks/paypal verifies via /v1/notifications/verify-webhook-signature; rejects on failure (400); logs WEBHOOK event; tested with sandbox webhook to Render URL.

title: STRETCH: Reauthorize button + honor-period countdown
ac: Endpoint 16 works or shows the PayPal error gracefully; UI countdown to honor_period_ends_at.

title: STRETCH: Payouts to worker after capture (simulated)
ac: After CAPTURED, optional POST /v1/payments/payouts to worker sandbox email; payout batch id in timeline; behind PAYOUTS_ENABLED=1.

title: App shell: layout, role switcher (?as=), nav, theme, shadcn setup, landing page with origin story
ac: / shows pitch + 3 role cards; ?as=customer|worker|reviewer sets pp_role cookie; header shows current role + 'Sandbox' badge; mobile responsive; Lighthouse a11y >= 90 on landing.

title: Customer: create job form + editable criteria preview
ac: /customer/new form (title, description, category, amount) posts to /api/jobs (use src/lib/api-client.ts typed with contracts; mock with MSW or fixture until T07 lands); criteria list editable (label, required, weight) with live weight total; liveness criterion locked.

title: PayPal Buttons checkout (intent=authorize) on job page
ac: @paypal/react-paypal-js (or SDK script) with intent=authorize&currency=USD; createOrder calls endpoint 5; onApprove calls endpoint 6; success shows 'Funds held' with authorization id and expiry; works with sandbox buyer login.

title: Worker: evidence upload (before/after, camera capture, previews, liveness code banner)
ac: /worker/jobs/[id]: two dropzones (before/after), capture=environment on mobile, thumbnails, remove; big banner 'Write code 4821 on paper and include it in an after photo'; Submit disabled until >=1 after image; calls endpoints 7–9.

title: Verification result view: per-criterion cards + bounding-box overlay + forensics flags
ac: Component <EvidenceViewer> draws box_2d [ymin,xmin,ymax,xmax]/1000 on images (scales with resize); <CriterionCard> shows verdict chip, confidence bar, rationale; hover card highlights boxes; flags panel (HIGH red, MEDIUM amber); built against eval fixture JSON first.

title: Money timeline + settlement panel (accept/decline partial, void, PayPal IDs)
ac: <MoneyTimeline> renders events (Held $120 -> Verified 4/5 -> Captured $96 -> Released $24) with PayPal order/auth/capture ids and sandbox links; agent proposal card with Accept/Decline calling endpoints 11–12; polling every 2s while VERIFYING.

title: Reviewer console: queue table, job detail, approve/partial/reject, evidence pack
ac: /reviewer lists HUMAN_REVIEW jobs (endpoint 17); detail reuses F05; decision form posts endpoint 13; 'Generate evidence pack' shows markdown (endpoint 18) with copy/download; passcode prompt if REVIEWER_PASSCODE set.

title: Demo polish: empty/loading/error states, copy, favicon, OG image, screenshots for README
ac: No raw JSON visible to users; toasts for errors; consistent copy; README screenshots in docs/img/; all pages work at 390px width.

title: STRETCH: AG Grid reviewer/ops grid (only if AG Grid sponsor chosen)
ac: AG Grid community grid of all jobs with status, held/captured/released amounts, flags; filter + sort; listed in Built With.

title: Eval dataset: shoot 12–20 before/after pairs + case.json labels (human-heavy)
ac: eval/pairs/NN-slug/{case.json,before_*.jpg,after_*.jpg} for >=12 cases from MANUAL §9.5 table; images <=1600px, no faces/PII; eval/stock has 2 images; Antigravity agent generated case.json skeletons + a validation script (npm run eval:validate) that passes.

title: Eval runner: npm run eval writes the eval report (+ --record fixtures for mock mode)
ac: scripts/eval.ts runs criteria(from case.json or generator)->forensics->VLM->decide per case; writes eval/report.md with confusion matrix, false-capture count, latency; --record writes eval/fixtures/<sha256>.json; report committed.

title: E2E happy path: create job -> sandbox PayPal authorize -> upload -> APPROVED -> CAPTURED
ac: tests/e2e/happy.spec.ts (Playwright) passes locally with VISION_MOCK=1 and sandbox buyer creds from env (E2E_BUYER_EMAIL/PASSWORD); Antigravity browser recording saved to docs/recordings/ (not committed if >10MB).

title: E2E partial + fraud paths (PARTIAL accept -> partial capture; duplicate -> HUMAN_REVIEW -> void)
ac: tests/e2e/partial.spec.ts and fraud.spec.ts pass; bugs found filed as Notion tasks (Status Todo, Owner by folder).

title: Demo dry-run on hosted Render URL; capture screenshots + backup screen recording
ac: All 3 demo jobs run on Render with sandbox; backup recording of each flow saved locally; list of glitches posted in Notion.

title: Fresh-clone judge test: follow README from zero in a clean folder
ac: New clone, only README instructions, VISION_MOCK=1: app runs and happy path completes; every README fix committed.

title: Record + edit demo video (<3:00), upload to YouTube public
ac: Video follows docs/DEMO_AND_SUBMISSION.md script, 2:40–2:55 long, captions on, no copyrighted music, public YouTube link in Notion.

title: Devpost submission: text, Built With, tools used, repo URL, video, hosted URL, testing instructions
ac: Checklist in docs/DEMO_AND_SUBMISSION.md all ticked; draft saved by Collaborator by 16:00 CET; Adarsh (team Representative) reviews and submits before 18:00 CET; repo public with MIT licence visible in About; screenshot of submission confirmation saved.
